    (
 		SELECT
			  DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT.*
			, (CASE WHEN DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' THEN FULLDATE ELSE AS_OF_DATE END) AOD_LATESTC
			,  CASE
				WHEN LEFT(DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT.CIF_ID,1) = 'R' then 'Retail'
				WHEN LEFT(DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT.CIF_ID,1) = 'C' then 'Corporate'
			  END AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
			, FULLDATE
            , PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
            , BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
            , DAYOFYEAR
            , YEAR
			, DATE_DIM.MONTH_END
			, DAY
			, (DATEDIFF(DAY, GREATEST(PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY,DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, FULLDATE), 0)), FULLDATE)-1) WH_DAY_DIFF_MONTH    
			, (DATEDIFF(DAY, GREATEST(PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY,DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, 0, FULLDATE), 0)), FULLDATE)-1) WH_DAY_DIFF_YEAR     
          FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
          JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT
            ON 1 = 1
            AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
			AND DEL_FLG = 'N'
            JOIN (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) MAX_AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT WHERE AS_OF_DATE <= CAST(@process_date AS DATE)) MX
            ON MX.MAX_AS_OF_DATE = AS_OF_DATE  OR (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE)>=AS_OF_DATE )
        WHERE (FULLDATE =CAST(@process_date AS DATE) )  
    ) TMP
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT CURRENT_BD
    ON  TMP.FULLDATE = CURRENT_BD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_ACID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT CURRENT_PBD
    ON  TMP.Previous_Business_Day = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT P_RUNNINGBAL
    ON  TMP.Previous_Business_Day  = P_RUNNINGBAL.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = P_RUNNINGBAL.GAM_ACID
